purpose: Claim -> exact source -> page -> verbatim quote for every load-bearing external constant in the estimator. Enforced by verify_research_ready.py check 10: each entry with a source_pdf + verbatim_quote must have that quote present (whitespace-normalized) in the PDF, or the check fails. Derived/external entries carry their derivation or citation instead of a local quote.
